Marcus (ML) and Soojin (SE) are looped; they'll lead the technical plan and test matrix. I attached a draft MAP and a working prompt set to accelerate the kickoff.

Deliverables we expect to complete within the MAP: a scoped eval SOW, test harness (data + prompts), baseline perf/latency report, and a recommended model/quantization profile for the pilot.

Thanks Devon — glad you can make Wed. Quick note on the technical eval plan so the kickoff can be efficient:

1) Success criteria (to validate during the 4-week eval):
   - Quality: pass threshold on QA set (F1/accuracy targets we can finalize at kickoff)
   - Latency: p95 < 450ms for the sample prompt set under continuous batching
   - Cost: projected token cost per 1k responses below the pilot budget target

2) Minimal test harness we will use (I attached the prompt set):
   - Ingest: CSV of 1k de-identified notes (sample included)
   - Runner: single-node harness that calls the Redwood hosted endpoint with KV prefix caching enabled
   - Metrics: token counts, per-request latency, model variant used, and error rates

3) Data & security: I will bring a short checklist for KMS, retention window, and audit log scope. If you can share the contact at your security/compliance team ahead of the kickoff, we’ll add them to the MAP.

I attached the prompt set I mentioned (eval_prompt_set_v0.3.txt). During the kickoff we can pick 3 seed prompts for the live run and a control set for regression checks.

--
